name: Bawang
introduce:
MCT-AP07 霸王
全称为「塔罗斯精神力机甲亚太七号机·霸王」，隶属于亚太战区，适配驾驶员为郑乐萱。
该机收集了原属世界秦末时期著名将领、军事家西楚霸王项羽的精神粒子作为动力炉内核，以高强度框架与诸多可拓展模块构筑机身，并搭载了独特的玄门磁极引擎·景——这一系列设计确保霸王拥有极为出色的防御与火力投射能力，足以在任何战场胜任「前沿支点」的职责。

30538.name: Cover Fire Mod
30538.SpecificEffects: DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>12%</color>. On the <color=#F74848>5th</color> or later hit, DMG dealt additionally increases by <color=#F74848>12%</color>. When equipped with two assault weapons, DMG multiplier increases by <color=#F74848>+0.05</color>. <buf ID=206242>[Sentry Mod]</buf> max stack increases by <color=#F74848>+3</color>, and gains <color=#F74848>4</color> stacks at the start of battle.

20624.name: Sentry Mod
20624.SpecificEffects: Before performing <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color> and Critical Hit chance increases by <color=#F74848>2%</color>, stacking up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
